description: Bgee rat Accsl expression calls across anatomical structures, with the rat Accs paralog as control
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
UA={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Accept':'application/json'}

def calls(gid, sid=10116, limit=10000):
    u=(f'https://www.bgee.org/api/?page=data&action=expr_calls&display_type=json'
       f'&gene_id={gid}&species_id={sid}&data_type=all&cond_param=anat_entity'
       f'&get_results=1&limit={limit}&offset=0')
    r=requests.get(u,headers=UA,timeout=120)
    if r.status_code!=200: return None
    j=r.json()
    cs=j['data']['expressionData']['expressionCalls']
    out=[]
    for c in cs:
        cond=c.get('condition',{})
        ae=cond.get('anatEntity',{}) or {}
        ct=(cond.get('cellType') or {}).get('name')
        es=c.get('expressionScore') or {}
        out.append({'anat_id':ae.get('id'),'anatomy':ae.get('name'),'cell_type':ct,
                    'state':c.get('expressionState'),'quality':c.get('expressionQuality'),
                    'score':float(es.get('expressionScore')) if es.get('expressionScore') not in (None,'NA') else np.nan,
                    'score_conf':es.get('expressionScoreConfidence'),'fdr':c.get('fdr'),
                    'rnaseq':(c.get('dataTypesWithData') or {}).get('RNA_SEQ'),
                    'scrna':(c.get('dataTypesWithData') or {}).get('SC_RNA_SEQ')})
    return pd.DataFrame(out)

acl=calls('ENSRNOG00000042533')
print('rat Accsl (ENSRNOG00000042533): Bgee calls =',len(acl))
print(acl['state'].value_counts().to_dict())
print('unique anatomical structures:',acl['anatomy'].nunique())
exp=acl[acl['state']=='expressed'].sort_values('score',ascending=False)
print(f"\nstructures called EXPRESSED: {exp['anatomy'].nunique()}")
print(exp[['anatomy','cell_type','score','quality','fdr']].head(15).to_string(index=False))
notexp=acl[acl['state']=='not_expressed']
print(f"\nstructures called NOT EXPRESSED: {notexp['anatomy'].nunique()}  (top by score)")
print(notexp.sort_values('score',ascending=False)[['anatomy','score','quality','fdr']].head(8).to_string(index=False))

# paralog control: rat Accs
j=requests.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene:Accs+AND+organism_id:10116&format=json&size=5',
               headers=UA,timeout=60).json()
bg=None
for e in j.get('results',[]):
    ids=[x['id'] for x in e.get('uniProtKBCrossReferences',[]) if x['database']=='Bgee']
    if ids: bg=ids[0]; print('\nrat Accs UniProt',e['primaryAccession'],'Bgee',bg); break
acs=calls(bg) if bg else None
if acs is not None:
    print('rat Accs: Bgee calls =',len(acs), acs['state'].value_counts().to_dict())
    e2=acs[acs['state']=='expressed']
    print(f"  structures called EXPRESSED: {e2['anatomy'].nunique()} of {acs['anatomy'].nunique()}")
    print(e2.sort_values('score',ascending=False)[['anatomy','score','quality']].head(8).to_string(index=False))

# ---- figure ----
def frac(df):
    g=df.groupby('anatomy')['state'].apply(lambda s:(s=='expressed').any())
    return g.mean(), g.sum(), len(g)
fa,ea,na=frac(acl)
fb,eb,nb=(frac(acs) if acs is not None else (np.nan,0,0))
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.4))
ax[0].bar(['Accsl','Accs'],[100*fa,100*fb],color=['#c44e52','#4c72b0'])
for i,(v,e_,n_) in enumerate([(100*fa,ea,na),(100*fb,eb,nb)]):
    ax[0].text(i,v+1.5,f'{v:.0f}%\n({e_}/{n_})',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylabel('anatomical structures with an expressed call (%)')
ax[0].set_ylim(0,105)
ax[0].set_title('a) Bgee expression calls, rat Accsl vs its paralog Accs',fontsize=10,loc='left')
top=exp.drop_duplicates('anatomy').head(12)
if len(top):
    ax[1].barh(top['anatomy'][::-1],top['score'][::-1],color='#c44e52')
    ax[1].set_xlabel('Bgee expression score (0-100 rank)')
    ax[1].set_title('b) Where rat Accsl is called expressed',fontsize=10,loc='left')
else:
    ax[1].text(0.5,0.5,'no structure called expressed',ha='center',va='center',transform=ax[1].transAxes)
    ax[1].set_axis_off()
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

acl.to_csv('/tmp/bgee_accsl.csv',index=False)
print('\nAccsl expressed-call anatomies in full:')
print(sorted(exp['anatomy'].dropna().unique())[:40])
